title: Update claude-api skill: Claude Opus 5.5 default, Claude Sonnet 5.5, …
content:
Update claude-api skill: Claude Opus 5.5 default, Claude Sonnet 5.5, build-eval and hillclimb guides (#1930)

* Update claude-api skill: Claude Opus 5.5 default, Claude Sonnet 5.5, build-eval and hillclimb guides

- Make Claude Opus 5.5 (`claude-opus-5-5`) the default model across SKILL.md,
  models.md, and every language's examples, with Claude Opus 5 as the previous
  Opus; add "Migrating to Claude Opus 5.5" to shared/model-migration.md
- Add Claude Sonnet 5.5 (`claude-sonnet-5-5`) as the current Sonnet, with
  Claude Sonnet 5 as the previous one, and update pricing, model-support
  callouts, and platform availability to match
- Add the build-eval and hillclimb flows under shared/evals/ (build-eval,
  eval-hillclimb, cost-hillclimb, eval-audit), the report schema, the lite HTML
  report builder, and the runner scaffold
- Add the preserved-thinking-migration subcommand with its cause reference and
  probe scripts, and note that drop_block can raise token usage
- Update cost-optimize f
author: rlancemartin
summary_zh: Anthropic 官方 skills 仓库更新了 claude-api skill，将 Claude Opus 5.5（claude-opus-5-5）设为所有语言示例中的默认模型，并新增 Claude Sonnet 5.5 及对应的定价、可用性和模型迁移说明。本次还在 shared/evals 下新增了 build-eval、eval-hillclimb、cost-hillclimb、eval-audit 等评测构建与迭代优化流程，并附带报告 schema 和简版 HTML 报告。这对用 Claude API 开发、做模型升级和效果评测迭代的开发者有直接参考价值。
pin_reason: 这是官方 skill 随 Opus 5.5 和 Sonnet 5.5 一起发布的里程碑更新，同时补充了权威的评测构建与爬坡优化指南，长期参考价值高。

title: sdk-v0.134.0
content: Features api: add execution_identity to Managed Agents agents api: add organization_type_not_supported error to spend limit lists api: add telemetry destination test endpoint api: add telemetry destinations to the Admin API client: emit OpenTelemetry spans for API calls, streams and tool runs. They are on by default and need no setup in the SDK: the spans appear once the application has registered a tracer provider with the OpenTelemetry API, and there are none without one. Requests carry the trace context in traceparent , and in the other headers that the registered propagator writes. This adds a dependency on @opentelemetry/api ( ^1.4.1 ). openTelemetry: false or ANTHROPIC_OPEN_TELEMETRY=false turns all of it off; openTelemetry: { propagation: false } or ANTHROPIC_OPEN_TELEMETRY_PROPAGATION=false keeps the spans and sends no trace headers; the variables apply only to a client that is given no openTelemetry option Bug Fixes api: rename telemetry destination test response model client:
author: anthropic-sdks-releaser[bot]
summary_zh: Anthropic TypeScript SDK v0.134.0 默认为 API 调用、流式响应和工具运行生成 OpenTelemetry span。应用注册 tracer provider 后无需额外配置即可接入链路追踪，也可以通过 openTelemetry 配置项或 ANTHROPIC_OPEN_TELEMETRY 环境变量关闭。本版本还给 Managed Agents 加了 execution_identity，并在 Admin API 中新增遥测目标管理及测试端点，方便在生产环境监控 LLM 应用。

title: v2.1.299
content: What's changed Added CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_FILE_MENTIONS environment variable: Claude gets the paths of @ file mentions to read with its file tools, not the files' contents Added idle compaction in the terminal: a 200K+ token conversation left idle for about 54 minutes is compacted before its one-hour prompt cache expires, so your next message doesn't reprocess it all Added CLAUDE_CODE_IDLE_COMPACT_MIN_TOKENS to change idle compaction's 200K-token minimum; "idleCompaction": false in settings.json turns it off. Both need v2.1.290 or later Added $.prompt.media so a prompt.submit hook of a mod installed by managed settings can read the bytes of an image or document attached to the prompt Added $.session.identity() for mods installed by managed settings: how the session is signed in, and its organization and email when managed forceLoginOrgUUID lists that organization Added size , weight , mono and tabular to a mod's Text and named spacing steps ( xs to xl ) to its Box ; bold is deprecated i
author: ashwin-ant
summary_zh: Claude Code v2.1.299 新增空闲压缩功能：上下文超过 20 万 token 的终端会话闲置约 54 分钟后会自动压缩，赶在一小时的提示缓存过期前完成，避免下次发消息时重新处理全部上下文。触发阈值可通过 CLAUDE_CODE_IDLE_COMPACT_MIN_TOKENS 调整，也可在 settings.json 中设 "idleCompaction": false 关闭。另外新增 CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_FILE_MENTIONS 环境变量（@ 文件提及只传路径、不传内容），并为托管设置安装的 mod 提供 $.prompt.media 和 $.session.identity() 接口，可读取提示附件和会话的登录身份与所属组织。

title: v1.14.0
content: Features api: add execution_identity to Managed Agents agents api: add organization_type_not_supported error to spend limit lists api: add telemetry destination test endpoint api: add telemetry destinations to the Admin API client: add OpenTelemetry tracing for API calls, streaming and tool runs Bug Fixes api: rename telemetry destination test response model client: close dropped streams without waiting for the collector streaming: pass unknown event types through the message stream helpers streaming: stop raising "Unexpected event order" for an event before message_start Chores docs: correct prefill, thinking, fallback and model descriptions docs: document the scope required to assign the managed role docs: update model examples internal: narrow the tripwire test rule in the contributor guides Documentation api: clarify when custom tool results can be sent api: say is_enabled is always true for user spend limits
author: anthropic-sdks-releaser[bot]
summary_zh: Anthropic Python SDK v1.14.0 给客户端加入了 OpenTelemetry 追踪，覆盖 API 调用、流式响应和工具运行；同时为 Managed Agents 增加 execution_identity，并在 Admin API 中新增遥测目标（telemetry destinations）管理和测试端点。这一版还修复了几个流式问题：未知事件类型现在会直接透传，message_start 之前收到事件也不再报“Unexpected event order”错误。对用 Python SDK 做 Agent 开发、需要可观测性的团队来说，这是一次很实用的更新。

title: v2.1.300
content: What's changed Added virtualText to a mod's prompt decorations: text drawn in the prompt box that never enters the draft or the submitted prompt Added cache_creation_5m_tokens and cache_creation_1h_tokens to the OpenTelemetry api_request event, splitting cache writes by lifetime Added $.ui.view({ agentId }) for mods: shows an agent's transcript in the main view when you ask, and $.ui.view({}) goes back Added a dir prop on a mod's Text for right-to-left text: on Windows and in VS Code's terminal its rows read in that direction and sit flush right Added /advisor on Claude Platform on AWS; no advisor runs until you pick one with /advisor , advisorModel or --advisor , and CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ADVISOR_TOOL=1 turns it off Added OpenTelemetry GenAI semantic-convention attributes to trace spans, such as gen_ai.provider.name , gen_ai.conversation.id , gen_ai.tool.name and error.type Added support for rewriting a workflow agent's prompt and model in the agent.spawn mod hook, which could only refu
author: ashwin-ant
summary_zh: Claude Code v2.1.300 版本更新：mod 新增多项 UI 能力，包括 prompt 装饰中的 virtualText、用 $.ui.view 查看 agent 记录，以及支持从右到左文本的 dir 属性。OpenTelemetry 的 api_request 事件开始按 5 分钟和 1 小时两种时长拆分缓存写入 token，trace span 也加入了 GenAI 语义约定属性。AWS 上的 Claude Platform 新增 /advisor，可以按需选择或禁用 advisor 模型。

title: v2.1.294
content: What's changed Fixed prompt and agent hooks written as instructions (such as "Block commands that...") allowing what they should block Improved how prompt hooks on Stop and SubagentStop written as instructions (such as "Carry on if the build is broken") are judged, so Claude is less likely to stop early
author: ashwin-ant
summary_zh: Claude Code v2.1.294 修复了一个问题：以指令形式编写的 prompt hook 和 agent hook（如"Block commands that..."）会放行本应阻止的操作。同时改进了 Stop 和 SubagentStop 上指令式 prompt hook（如"Carry on if the build is broken"）的判断方式，Claude 提前停止的情况会更少。依赖 hook 做安全拦截或流程控制的用户应尽快升级。

title: How Third Moment Research runs 10,000 agents for 36+ hours
content: With GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol, Codex, and Daybreak for cybersecurity, this AI lab builds agents that focus for days and improve with use.
summary_zh: OpenAI 官方案例：AI 实验室 Third Moment Research 用 GPT-6 Astra、GPT-6.1 Sol、Codex 和网络安全工具 Daybreak，同时运行 1 万个智能体，单次连续工作超过 36 小时。文章重点讲如何让智能体长时间保持专注，并在使用中不断变好，对设计大规模、长时程的 Agent 工作流有参考价值。不过目前只有摘要，具体技术细节还不清楚。

title: v0.2.166
content: New Features Hook-specific output types : Added typed output classes and missing input fields for hooks, giving hook implementations precise type information instead of untyped dicts ( #1331 ) SystemInitData TypedDict : The init system message payload is now fully typed via SystemInitData , along with nested types SystemInitMcpServer , SystemInitPlugin , SystemInitPluginError , and FastModeState / FastModeDisabledReason literals. Use cast(SystemInitData, msg.data) to access typed fields like capabilities , model , mcp_servers , and more ( #1332 ) Bug Fixes Fixed SandboxSettings.ignoreViolations type : Changed from a TypedDict with file / network keys to dict[str, list[str]] to match the CLI's actual schema — a map from command-pattern substring to violation-text substrings. The old type caused "file" and "network" to be interpreted as command patterns, and strict type checkers rejected the correct {"*": [...]} shape ( #1380 ) Internal/Other Changes Updated bundled Claude CLI to version
author: github-actions[bot]
summary_zh: Claude Agent SDK Python v0.2.166 新增了 hook 专用的类型化输出类，并补全了 hook 缺失的输入字段，hook 实现因此拿到精确的类型信息，不再处理无类型的 dict。init 系统消息的载荷现在通过 SystemInitData TypedDict 完整定型，包括 MCP 服务器、插件、FastMode 状态等嵌套类型。本版还修复了 SandboxSettings.ignoreViolations 的类型定义，使其与 CLI 实际使用的 schema 一致。

title: Amp puts AI agents to work beyond code with OpenAI models
content: See how Amp pushes the frontier of what agents can do with GPT-6 Astra, Ultrafast, GPT-Live-1, and Sign in with ChatGPT.
summary_zh: OpenAI 官方博客介绍了编程代理工具 Amp 的案例：Amp 借助 GPT-6 Astra、Ultrafast、GPT-Live-1 等模型以及 Sign in with ChatGPT 登录方式，把 AI 代理的用途从写代码扩展到更多工作场景。文章对了解 AI 编程代理的产品方向和多模型集成有参考价值，但给出的内容很少，缺少具体的技术细节和实践方法。
